_meta: Single source of truth for the halftrend_ema_v1 strategy parameters that used to be declared twice: once as an MQL5 `input` default in mt5/Experts/XauAssistant.mq5, once as a module constant in scripts/backtest.py. The EA inputs are the LIVE authority -- this file must match them, not the other way around. service/tests/test_strategy_config.py::test_strategy_config_matches_the_ea enforces that match on every run (numeric compare, so 50 and 50.0 agree). Do not add a key here without wiring it into both the EA input table above the test and the backtest loader in scripts/backtest.py -- an unmapped key fails the completeness check in the same test file.
